question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

One that cannot be harmed/wounded
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Invulnerable'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word that can substitute the group of words "One that cannot be harmed/wounded" is **"Invulnerable".**
 
• **"Invulnerable"** means incapable of being wounded, hurt, or damaged.
 
• It comes from the Latin word "invulnerabilis" from in- "not" + vulnerabilis "woundable".
 
• The correct Hindi translation of **"Invulnerable"** is "अभेद्य", which means something that can't be harmed or breached.

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: '**Invulnerable'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Mortal"** refers to a being that is susceptible to death;(नश्वर)
 
• **"Mystic" **refers to a person who seeks spiritual experiences or realities beyond the normal human experience, often through prayer or deep contemplation. (रहस्यवादी)
 
• **"Bigot" **refers to a person who is intolerantly devoted to his or her own opinions and prejudices.(कट्टर)
